channel.title: New MES Calculators & Tools
channel.description: New free calculators and tools on mes.fm.

item.title: Investment Tracker
item.description: A private portfolio tracker for stocks, ETFs and crypto: live prices, gains, dividends, realized gains by tax year, wallet balances and CSV import.

item.title: RSS Feeds
item.description: Follow everything new on MES in any feed reader: tools, posts, livestreams and videos. No account, no algorithm; updates announced on Hive with Podping.

item.title: Falling Blocks
item.description: Marathon, Sprint 40, Ultra and Zen with T-spins, hold and ghost, in 2D or 3D; daily race, live races and a Hive leaderboard.

item.title: Screen Recorder
item.description: Record your screen, a window or a tab with your camera and microphone, take screenshots, mix the sound and save MP4. No install, nothing uploaded.

item.title: AI Detector
item.description: Was a picture, video or text made with AI? Reads Content Credentials and AI labels, runs an on-device model and checks text patterns. Evidence, not guesses.

item.title: Space Shuttle Simulator
item.description: Fly the Shuttle around a 3D Earth: plan burns, raise and tilt the orbit, catch the ISS or Hubble, then de-orbit and glide down to the runway. Plus why it could never reach the Moon.

item.title: Expense Splitter
item.description: Split a group trip fairly: by nights stayed, shares or exact amounts, non-drinkers left out, fewest payments to settle up.

item.title: MES AI
item.description: Chat with top AI models (Claude Sonnet and Opus) for coding, research and writing, and make pictures. See the price first, pay per message in HBD. No plan.

item.title: Voids & Ductile Fracture Simulator
item.description: Watch microscopic voids grow and link inside a necking bar until it cracks from the middle: cup and cone, dimples, triaxiality.

item.title: Click Speed Test
item.description: Clicks per second for mouse, taps (every finger counts) or Space bar; 1 to 100 s, chart, best scores, world record.

item.title: MES Mail
item.description: Quantum-safe encrypted email between Hive accounts: threads, replies, Sent folder and a classic memo reader. No server, no sign-up.

item.title: Package Tracker
item.description: Paste, scan or photograph any tracking number and open the right carrier’s tracking page: USPS, UPS, FedEx, DHL, Royal Mail, Canada Post and 50 more.

item.title: AI Image Upscaler
item.description: Make photos, anime and drawings 2x, 4x or 8x bigger, or 4K wide, with sharp AI detail. Runs in your browser: nothing is uploaded.

item.title: Darkroom: Photo Library & RAW Editor
item.description: A free Lightroom alternative: rate and keyword your photos, develop RAW files with curves, colour grading, masks and healing, then batch export. Nothing is uploaded.

item.title: Transcript & Timestamps
item.description: Get a YouTube video's transcript with clickable times, make chapter timestamps for your description, download TXT, SRT or VTT. 3Speak, Odysee and files too.

item.title: Quantum Computer Simulator
item.description: Drag gates onto up to 10 qubits and watch the state vector and Bloch sphere step by step: Bell, teleportation, Grover, QFT and Shor examples, shots and OpenQASM.

item.title: Quantum-Safe Website Checker
item.description: Paste links and see if each site's HTTPS uses post-quantum encryption (X25519MLKEM768), with its TLS version and certificate, graded A to F.

item.title: Quantum Cryptography
item.description: Send a key with photons (BB84), watch Shor's algorithm factor and Grover's search find, see what is quantum-safe, and run real post-quantum ML-KEM (Kyber).

item.title: Cryptography Lab
item.description: Encrypt, decrypt and crack Caesar and Vigenère ciphers, build RSA keys from primes step by step, Diffie-Hellman, hashes and real AES password encryption.

item.title: Text Viewer (TXT, RTF, Code)
item.description: Open .txt, .md, .rtf, .csv, .json, .html and code files: a formatted reading view or a code view with line numbers, read aloud, edit and save. Nothing is uploaded.

item.title: Narration
item.description: Type a script, get a voice-over: 28 natural voices or your own voice from a 15-second sample. MP3, M4A or WAV, or straight into the Video Editor.

item.title: Car Sandbox
item.description: Drive cars, trucks and a lunar rover in 3D on a test track, the Moon, Mars or Ceres: jumps, a loop, crashes, computer cars, loose objects and any gravity you like.

item.title: Chess
item.description: Play the computer, a friend, online or on Hive, in 2D or 3D venues, with Chess960, clocks and analysis.

item.title: Bridge Builder
item.description: Design a truss, arch or cable bridge, check every member, auto-size it for the lowest cost, then drive trucks over it, blow wind and shake it with an earthquake.

item.title: Brick Builder (3D building bricks)
item.description: Build with virtual bricks in 3D, start from example builds for kids and bridges, test how much weight your build holds and follow the steps with real bricks.

item.title: Lüders Band Simulator
item.description: Pull a mild steel bar and watch the yield band run along it at 55° while the force stays flat. Notches, machine stiffness, strain ageing.

item.title: Prime Numbers
item.description: Is it prime? Prime factors, divisors, coprime, GCD and LCM, the sieve and the prime spiral.

item.title: Quantum Calculators
item.description: de Broglie wavelength, photon energy, the uncertainty principle, tunnelling probability, particle in a box, the Bohr model, Compton shift and blackbody radiation, with every formula shown.

item.title: Quantum Lab
item.description: Watch a wave packet tunnel through a barrier, build double-slit stripes one particle at a time, run a Bell test on entangled pairs, send atoms through Stern-Gerlach magnets and explore hydrogen orbitals.

item.title: Billiards: 8-Ball, 9-Ball & Snooker
item.description: Pool and snooker with real spin physics, against the computer, a friend or a Hive player, plus trick-shot challenges.

item.title: Watch
item.description: Watch YouTube, 3Speak, Odysee and Rumble videos on a plain page: no recommendations or comments. Up next list, save for later, resume, speed.

item.title: GTA 6 Hub
item.description: Unofficial GTA 6 tools: the unlock time in your time zone, how long the 212 GB download takes, a stunt jump simulator and the latest news.

item.title: Stunt Jump Simulator
item.description: Jump cars, bikes and monster trucks over gaps and canyons with real suspension physics: airtime, rotation, landing g-force and the speed window for a clean landing.

item.title: Relative Speed & Strength Calculator
item.description: Animal speeds (running, flying, swimming), strength, jumps and falls scaled to human size.

item.title: Party Invitations & RSVP
item.description: Make a themed invitation, send one link and see who's coming: Going / Maybe / Can't go, plus-ones, waitlist, what to bring. No sign-up for anyone.

item.title: Connect Four
item.description: Connect 3, 4, 5 or 6 on any board, against the computer, a friend or a Hive player.

item.title: Relative Time Calculator
item.description: How long an hour feels at another age: share of life, felt life and animal lifespans.

item.title: Minesweeper
item.description: Classic levels, daily board, no-guess boards and hexagons; best times saved, optionally on Hive.

item.title: Maps: Projections, Globe & Capitals
item.description: Morph between 28 map projections, spin a globe with day and night, explore countries, capitals and states, drag countries to their true size, measure great circles and play a geography quiz.

item.title: Tic-Tac-Toe
item.description: Classic, ultimate, 3D, gomoku, Notakto and more, against the computer, a friend or someone online.

item.title: Font Finder: What Font Is This?
item.description: Drop or paste a picture and find the font among 2,000+ free fonts and the fonts on your computer, with your letters shown next to each match. Private: nothing is uploaded.

item.title: Crash Physics Simulator
item.description: Fire anything at anything: pick the material, speed and plate thickness and see if it bounces, sticks or goes through. Crash cars, drop eggs, read the g-forces.

item.title: YouTube Audio Analyzer
item.description: How loud is that video? Loudness in LUFS, true peak, waveform, spectrogram, silences and clipping for YouTube, 3Speak, Rumble, Odysee or your own files.

item.title: Maxwell's Vortices
item.description: A wire bent into a loop becomes a magnet, the electron's magnetic moment, Maxwell's 1861 spinning cells and idle wheels carrying currents and waves, and two magnets attracting or repelling.

item.title: Quaternion Lab
item.description: Multiply i, j, k and watch a 3D hand half-turn, see why i² = −1, compare SLERP with Euler angles on a robot arm, convert rotations and see the 720° spinor turn.

item.title: Spin Wave Field
item.description: A double-slit pattern forms in a crowd that waves with the wave, a 360° spin flipper swaps bright and dark stripes (720° brings them back), and a 3D wave field with tracer particles.

item.title: Spin-½ Lab
item.description: Dirac's belt trick in 3D: one turn tangles the ribbons, two turns untangle them, plus five pictures of why spin ½ needs 720°, a phase-coloured torus and an elastic sheet that lies flat only after 720°.

item.title: Practice Tests (FSA Style)
item.description: Grade 4 and 7 numeracy and reading practice with new questions every time and every answer explained.

item.title: Hologram Simulator
item.description: Record interference fringes live, play the hologram back with real wave optics, see parallax and the twin image, compare hologram types and compute a phase hologram of your drawing.

item.title: Gallery
item.description: View the photos and videos in your folders: fast thumbnails, rows, masonry or list, slideshow, zoom, favourites, and video speed 0.25x to 4x with A-B loops. Nothing is uploaded.
